# strided-rs v0.7.1

Additive release of `strided-exec` only; the other crates stay at 0.7.0 and accept 0.7.1.

- **`Exec::can_broadcast(&self) -> bool`.** Non-consuming; true exactly when `broadcast` would
  not refuse right now (the token is not fork-derived and the caller is not a worker of its
  pool; serial and budget-one tokens return true). Ask it before building a setup that only a
  broadcast needs. `broadcast` and `can_broadcast` share one private rule.
- **Deterministic pool shutdown.** Dropping a `Pool` now joins all of its worker threads, after
  their thread-local destructors (including `on_start` state) have run. A pool dropped from one
  of its own workers cannot join itself and skips joining. Workers are started with Rayon's
  `spawn_handler` using the same name and stack size; steady-state paths still allocate nothing.

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1
